query_evidence.question: ORACLE B5 for scenarios Q03 (clarified: weekly, 2 weeks)
query_evidence.sql:
WITH resolved_sessions AS (SELECT s.session_id, s.session_started_at, s.last_activity_at, s.platform, s.country_at_event,
       COALESCE(s.user_id,
                (SELECT MIN(l.user_id) FROM identity_links l
                 WHERE l.session_id = s.session_id
                 GROUP BY l.session_id
                 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.user_id) = 1)) AS resolved_user_id
FROM sessions s), w(week, ws, we) AS (VALUES ('2026-07-27','2026-07-27T00:00:00Z','2026-08-03T00:00:00Z'),('2026-08-17','2026-08-17T00:00:00Z','2026-08-24T00:00:00Z'))
SELECT w.week, COALESCE(u.acquisition_source,'unknown') AS source, COUNT(DISTINCT r.resolved_user_id) AS wau
FROM w JOIN resolved_sessions r ON r.resolved_user_id IS NOT NULL AND r.session_started_at < w.we AND r.last_activity_at >= w.ws
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = r.resolved_user_id
GROUP BY w.week, 2 UNION ALL
SELECT w.week, 'TOTAL', COUNT(DISTINCT r.resolved_user_id) FROM w JOIN resolved_sessions r ON r.resolved_user_id IS NOT NULL AND r.session_started_at < w.we AND r.last_activity_at >= w.ws GROUP BY w.week
ORDER BY 1,2
